topics.title: Methods
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to apply/synthesize the methods and models used to value pension benefits for various purposes.

outcomes.text: Differentiate between the various purposes for valuing pension plans
Perform periodic valuations of ongoing plans, calculating normal cost and actuarial accrued liability, using a variety of cost methods
Analyze and communicate the pattern of cost recognition that arises under a variety of cost methods
Analyze and communicate the impact on cost stability of a variety of asset valuation methods

topics.title: Actuarial Assumptions
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to analyze/synthesize the factors that go into selection of actuarial assumptions used in pension valuations Given a context, including valuations for specific purposes (funding, accounting, termination/windup) and for different types of plans (single employer, multi-employer, open, closed, public), the Candidate will be able to:

outcomes.text: Describe and explain the different perspectives on the selection and development of assumptions, including financial economics
Recommend appropriate assumptions and defend the selection
Evaluate actual experience, including comparisons to assumptions

topics.title: Accounting Standards
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to perform valuations and prepare disclosure information for retirement income plans under applicable accounting standards.

outcomes.text: Perform calculations in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including:
Advise plan sponsors on common accounting methods, costs and disclosures for retirement plans under various standards and interpretations
Demonstrate the sensitivity of financial measures to given changes in plan design
Perform and interpret the results of projections for short-term planning including the effect of proposed plan changes

topics.title: Retirement Plan Investment and Risk Management
topics.objective: The candidate will recognize and appropriately reflect the role of retirement plan investments in managing plan sponsor risk and make recommendations.

outcomes.text: Evaluate the interaction of plan investments with various valuation methods and assumptions
Evaluate how factors including cash flow requirements, various plan designs and various economic environments affect setting investment strategy
Describe strategies and techniques for asset/liability management
Provide advice and analysis to plan sponsors regarding the mitigation of investment risks
